rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something basic or limited to the minimum necessary.

example.english: This camera has rudimentary functions that are only enough for everyday photography.
example.traditional: 呢部相機嘅功能好基本，淨係夠應付日常影相。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 soeng2 gei1 ge3 gung1 nang4 hou2 gei1 bun2 zing6 hai6 gau3 jing3 fu6 jat6 soeng4 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this for something at an early or preliminary stage, including only a preliminary understanding.

example.english: I only have a rudimentary understanding of this plan and need to study it further.
example.traditional: 我對呢個計劃只有初步了解，仲要再研究。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zi2 jau5 co1 bou6 liu5 gaai2 zung6 jiu3 zoi3 jin4 gau3

rows.note: Use this when a person's knowledge or understanding is limited and not deep, rather than when a thing is simply at an early stage.

example.english: My knowledge of the law is rudimentary, so I don't dare give opinions casually.
example.traditional: 我對法律嘅認識好粗淺，唔敢亂畀意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 faat3 leot6 ge3 jing6 sik1 hou2 cou1 cin2 m4 gam2 lyun6 bei2 ji3 gin3
